name: zclass_type_list_free_all
description: zClass_TypeList::FreeAll walks and frees the cached free-link list until the global free-list head is null.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x44e6d0 loads g_zClass_TypeList_FreeLinkHead, loops while non-null, stores the current link's next pointer back to the global head, calls the free provider on the current link, reloads the global head, and returns when null.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x44e6d0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same free-list drain and CRT free provider calls.
The dependency frontier for 0x44e6d0 has no visible source blockers; the only callee is the accepted free provider.
The native zclass_type_list_alloc_and_insert_smoke builds a two-entry free-link list, calls zClass_TypeList::FreeAll, and verifies g_zClass_TypeList_FreeLinkHead is null.
